title: Georgia ZIP codes and the districts they touch
description: Per ZIP, the counties and districts that TOUCH it, never 'your district': a ZIP can span several, and only a street address identifies the districts a voter lives in. State Senate, state House and U.S. House shares are estimated from HUD residential-address ratios and 2020 Census population by 2023 district.

kind.description: standard = a USPS Georgia delivery ZIP; po-box = PO-box-only, carries no districts; other = HUD reports addresses but the ZIP is not in the USPS Georgia facility list (campus, government, military); treat like standard.
